newsitem.title: USA: Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas sets exploration.
newsitem.headline: Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas sets exploration.

text.p: Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas Corp said Tuesday it signed an exploration agreement with Pitchfork Land and Cattle Company and Toreador Royalty Corp covering some 137,000 acres in Dickens and King Counties, Texas, on the Eastern Shelf of the Midland Basin.

The agreement gives the company the right to conduct 3-D seismic operations and an exclusive option to acquire leases on the acreage, Louis Dreyfus said. The initial seismic survey will cover about 30 square miles and is expected to start during the fourth quarter of this year.

The company said the principal objective will be the Tannehill Sands (Permian age) at depths of less than 5,000 feet. Producing Tannehill wells contiguous to the acreage are expected to recover an average of 200,000 barrels of oil per well. Deeper potential exists in the Strawn formation at about 6,000 feet in depth.
Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas said it will be the operator and own a minimum of 77.5 percent working interest in the project.
